<?php
class QuietVoidRead {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): void { echo "G;"; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { global $written; echo "S;"; $written = $value; }
}
function quietVoidRhs(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$written = 42;
$receiver = new QuietVoidRead;
$selector = "probe";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo ($receiver->missing ?? quietVoidRhs()) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD_FALL;";
echo ($receiver->value ??= quietVoidRhs()) === 9 ? "ASSIGN;" : "BAD_ASSIGN;";
echo $written === 9 ? "SET;" : "BAD_SET;";
echo ($receiver->skip ?? quietVoidRhs()) === 9 ? "SKIP;" : "BAD_SKIP;";
echo $selector === "probe" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
$receiver = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): never {
        global $selector;
        echo "G;";
        $selector = "changed";
    }
};
function quietNeverRhs(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$selector = "lost";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $receiver->$selector ?? quietNeverRhs(); }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getLine(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious() === null ? "ROOT;" : "BAD_ROOT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "changed" ? "NAME_CHANGED;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietThrowNeverRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): never { global $receiver, $original; echo "G;"; $receiver = null; throw $original; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietThrowNeverRhs(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new QuietThrowNeverRead;
$weak = WeakReference::create($receiver);
$original = new Exception("original");
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $receiver->missing ?? quietThrowNeverRhs(); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure === $original ? "SAME;" : "BAD_THROW;"; echo $failure->getPrevious() === null ? "ROOT;" : "BAD_ROOT;"; }
echo $weak->get() === null ? "DEAD;" : "BAD_LIVE;";
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $receiver === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietExitNeverRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): never { global $receiver; echo "G;"; $receiver = null; exit(13); }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$receiver = new QuietExitNeverRead;
$destination = 42;
$destination = $receiver->missing ?? 9;
echo "BAD_AFTER;";
